title: AdapTiV: Sign-Similarity Based Image-Adaptive Token Merging for Vision Transformer Acceleration
problem: Vision Transformers suffer from quadratic self-attention complexity and token redundancy that cause high computational costs. Existing token merging strategies are inefficient due to expensive computations and fixed merge rates that degrade latency performance.
motivation: Accelerating Vision Transformers with reduced latency and energy consumption enables practical deployment across edge and server systems.
method: AdapTiV combines three algorithmic innovations—Local Matching to restrict token search space, Sign Similarity for simplified token similarity computation, and Dynamic Merge Rate for image-adaptive merging—with a specialized Adaptive Token Merging Engine that uses Sign-Driven Scheduling to hide token merging overhead within the Layer Normalization process using a lightweight sign scratchpad memory.
key_novelty: Sign-Similarity metric combined with image-adaptive dynamic merge rates to enable efficient token merging while hiding computational overhead in existing Layer Normalization operations.
contributions: Adaptive Token Merging Engine hardware with Sign-Driven Scheduling to hide token merging latency
Sign Similarity metric simplifying token similarity computation while maintaining accuracy
Local Matching algorithm reducing token merging search space and computational complexity
Dynamic Merge Rate enabling adaptive token merging based on image content
primary_theme: Vision Transformer acceleration through adaptive token merging
